class.name: BoneClothCollisionTaperedCapsule3D
class.brief_description: A capsule collision with a different radius at each end, for [BoneClothSimulator3D].
class.description: A capsule collision with a different radius at each end, for [BoneClothSimulator3D], such as for a thigh. It lies along the node's Y axis, with [member top_radius] at the +Y end.

members.member: The full height, including the ends. It is at least twice the larger radius.
If [code]true[/code], the collision keeps the chains inside it.
